notes.title: Update v1.1.0 - Achievements & Bugfixes
notes.content:
Players!

In this update we introduce achievements, a timer and a bunch of bugfixes.

[h2]Achievement[/h2]
There are 16 of them, most of which can be unlocked retroactively, meaning for example if you already collected more than 10k gold, you will get the "Rich" achievement as soon as you open the "Skills" screen. Happy achieving!

[h2]Timer[/h2]
There is now a timer that you can activate in the options.

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
We also fixed a bunch of bugs:

[b]Hardmode[/b]
Fixed a bug were hardmode didn't actually do anything sometimes.

[b]Gold ability[/b]
Fixed a typo that said "2% more gold" instead of 20%.

[b]Icy Sphere[/b]
The first upgrade was mistakenly free and now costs gold again. 

[b]Skills[/b]
If you had unlocked the last meta upgrade you would be shown the first one again, it now always shows the last one if you unlocked everything.

[b]Input lag after Pause/Level Up[/b]
Sometimes the player would not move for a short moment after the Pause/Level up, this should be fixed now.

[b]Level selection[/b]
After playing the Graveyard level the level selection was bugged and showed an empty level in the first slot.

[b]Poison Breath[/b]
Some enemies would not get hit by poison breath even if they stood directly in it.

[b]Crit chance[/b]
The crit chance is not displayed in the description text of the meta upgrade.

notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Dear Players,

in this update we're activating Steam cloud saves, which enables you to transfer game progress between different devices and installs. If you have previously played on multiple devices Steam will prompt you for which save game to keep. If you don't want to use Steam cloud saves you can disable it by navigation to the game in your library and deactivating the feature under Properties -> General.

Ninjas could previously move even if they should have been frozen in place by an ability, this is now fixed. 

The mouse cursor is now hidden ingame, except in menus or if you move it. And the game pauses should your controller disconnect during play.

If you find any bugs please let us know and we will fix them ASAP.

Best wishes

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.content:
Dear Players,

in this update we fixed a bug in the skill screen where the game would buy skills that you didn't intend to buy. We also introduce a refund option, so if you were affected by this bug, or just want to skill differently you can now refund all your skills.

We also made some slight changes to the ability selection with a controller, to make the experience more smooth, and removed some unnecessary code for minor performance improvements.

If you encounter any bugs please let us know, and we will fix them as soon as we can.

Best wishes,
bareminimumgames
